$comment: #EXP-1493 THE PLAN PAGE ×4 (owner 2026-10-31, thread b836a4a9: 'big plans ... are unusable as stories: you step through everything'): the EXPANDED FORM of THE plan card (plan-card.json), one system, never a second plan UI. Web packages/ui plan-page.tsx + the route `route` (apps/web routes/t/$teamSlug/sessions/$sessionId.plan.$messageId.tsx), desktop crates/ui plan_page.rs (a tab of the session pane), iOS ExpUI PlanPage.swift + Android ui/plan/PlanPage.kt (a pushed page); models: desktop domain::plan_page, iOS ExpCore PlanPage.swift, Android domain/PlanPage.kt replay EVERY *Cases array comparing the WHOLE expected value. MODEL (pure, src/plan-page.ts): `planBlocks(markdown)` (`blockCases`) splits the card's `plan` GFM in order: every `## ` line outside a code fence = a `section` block {id, title} (title = the heading's plain text: links to their text, ** __ ` dropped; id = `sectionSlug`: lowercase, every run of anything but a-z0-9 = `-`, edges trimmed, empty = `section`; a repeat gets `-2`, `-3`…); a RUN of two or more picture-only lines (`![alt](src)` alone on its line, blank lines between them allowed) = ONE `pictures` block {pictures: [{alt, src}]}; a lone picture stays in the prose; a pending `upload:` picture renders NOTHING (dropped, also inline); the rest = `markdown` blocks (blank edge lines trimmed, empty ones dropped). `planOutline(markdown)` (`outlineCases`) = one row per section {id, title, pictures} (pictures = what the blocks after it show until the next section; fenced code shows none; the prose before the first section is in no row). `planCounts(card)` (`countCases`) = {sections: the outline's length, pictures: the card's RESOLVED pictures (attachmentId set), questions: the card's questions}; `planCountsLine(counts)` (`countsLineCases`) = the non-zero parts in that order, `copy.counts` singular for 1, ` · ` between; all zero = ``. `planPageFor(sessionId, messages)` (`targetCases`) = the NEWEST (createdAt, then id) plan card the session posted ITSELF (author_session_id = session_id), no engine `questionId`, `decision` null; else null. `mosaicTiles(count)` (`mosaicCases`) = THE wide picture group (eUI `Mosaic`): 1 = one large tile, 2 = two `half` tiles side by side, 3+ = the first `large` on the left (both rows) and the next two `small` stacked on the right, the last carrying `more` = count − 3 ("+N" over it, scrim black 0.55); geometry `mosaic`: `gap` between tiles, the large tile `largeFraction` of the width, the whole group `aspect` w/h, `radius` + the glass-stroke hairline, pictures cover. LAYOUT. WIDE (web md+, the IDE) = three columns under ONE header row (`layout.headerHeight`, a hairline under it): the header = the back chevron, the chat's name muted, `/`, `copy.title` semibold, the KIND BADGE (stories.json `badge`, `Plan`; waiting = + a 6 px needs-you dot (the sidebar's `needsYou` tone, `semantic.yellow`; no word)) then flex, the counts line muted (`planCountsLine`), `copy.openChat` (ghost), the close glyph. LEFT = THE OUTLINE (eUI `Outline`, `layout.outlineWidth`, a hairline on its right): the `copy.outline` caption (2xs uppercase muted) then one row per section (`layout.outlineRowHeight`, the title one line truncated, a muted `· n` when it has pictures), the ACTIVE row (scroll-spy: the last section whose heading passed the top of the column; none yet = no active row) = the accent background + a `layout.outlineActiveBar` px foreground bar on its leading edge; a press scrolls the document to that section; then a separator and the QUESTIONS row (`copy.questions`, trailing `· n`) that scrolls nothing (the rail already shows them); no section and no question = no outline column. CENTRE = THE DOCUMENT, one scroll, a column `layout.columnMaxWidth` wide centred, `layout.columnPadding` (wide/phone) above and on the sides, `layout.blockGap` between blocks: `markdown` = THE chat markdown renderer at the body size (plan-card.json `card` headingScale etc.), `section` = an h2 (THE markdown h2) carrying the anchor, `pictures` = wide: THE Mosaic; phone: THE eUI Carousel (one slide per picture at its aspect, the "i / n" counter top-left, dots under it, swipe). A press on ANY picture (mosaic tile, carousel slide, an inline picture) opens THE lightbox (`ImagePreviewDialog` + guide-viewer `‹ i / n ›`) over EVERY picture of the plan in document order. RIGHT = THE RAIL (`layout.railWidth`, the sidebar background, a hairline on its left, STICKY: it never scrolls with the document): the `copy.questions` heading + plan-card.json `stepper` (its step label, the segments, one question at a time, Back / Next) and pinned to its foot the decision (ask-dock `planOptions`: No, keep planning / Yes ▾, the answer-issue line over it, the feedback field after the reject pick); a plan without questions = the decision alone; answered or superseded = the CLOSED card (picks, `planDecisionLabel`, the feedback line), no decision row. PHONE (iOS, Android, web-mobile) = the SAME document in one scroll under a page header (the back chevron, `copy.title`, the outline toggle glyph `ui-menu` when the outline has a row): the kind badge + the h1 title + the counts line lead the column; the outline opens in THE eUI Drawer (bottom sheet, the same rows); the bottom = THE Dock with ONE DockCard, dock.json's plan card UNCHANGED (`dockRows` of the plan: `Plan ready`, the asking session's name, `n questions`, the plan's title) floating over the document's foot; a tap opens THE Dock sheet QUESTIONS-ONLY (plan-card `stepper` without its plan page: the document is the page; fewer than `stepper.minQuestions` = every question on one page) with THE decision; NO composer on this page ('No, keep planning' carries the feedback); decided = the same sheet shows the closed card. A decision on the page goes through THE card-answer path (`sessions.answer`) and the page stays open, closed. WAYS IN ×4 (all open THIS page for that message): the story viewer's plan frame `copy.openPlan` (stories.json footer `open`); the chat's plan card header action (`copy.openPlan`, a ghost button with `ui-fullscreen`); the Dock sheet header glyph `ui-fullscreen` (`copy.openFull`); an inbox row / push whose `inboxRowTarget` is a session with `planPageFor` ≠ null; the Needs-you row (thread-row-action.json) of a plan: `copy.openPlan` next to its open-chat link. Deep link: the web path `planPagePath(teamSlug, sessionId, messageId)`; a message that is not a plan card = the session.
